full_page.content:
1923, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 1 Cont.
Dec. 9th Mary Briggi - joined her brother V. today -- been drinking for five years -- Very careless about Church etc. Dec. 14th re- ports very hopeful that his drinking is over - as determined on the 12th.
Page 2
Dec. 11th J.J.G. Steam fitter away from home and heart-broken - robbed of everything by non-catholic wife - who takes even his little son and only child. His mother enrolled him to-day perpetual- ly .
17 Alfred Ant. Refert - 18 yrs out till 4 a.m. Sunday - practical Catholic otherwise -- in bad company upseting peace in family, drinking, etc. - Jan. 4 -- Alfred went to Sacraments Christmas -- Escaped terrible & notorious misfortune of former comrade -- is doing idially -- "Nothing less than miraculous" == His sister
Dec. 19 Mrs. Hurley 168 - E. 112 St. Reports Husband made Easter-duty & stopped drinking - Wife 10 yrs younger than before - happy and content
Dec. 29 H. Keogh - father of 3 - drinks neglects family careless; en- rolled today
1924
1924, January
Jan. 2nd Helene Cahill - play write anxious and somewhat discouraged at not suceeding .... 301 - W. 118 St - c/o Keelan
4 J. O'Connor) 25 - once at Com. since home from War - good son
4 Thomas Ro - (Perpetual) not coming home till 2-3-4 o'clock A.M. - careless etc.
Jan. 7 E. Fisher -- Drinking getting agnry -- enrolled to-day for year.
8 Sara Clarey - to be operated on to-morrow serious - enrolls Poor Souls .
Jan 8 Mrs. Catheline M. Sawler Enrolled May 3rd 1923 - given 3 days to live with pneumonia - family Dr. gave her 3 hours - report - Recovered completely has two fine Babies.
